FIELDS.NAME: AutoZone Parts & Accessories
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: AutoZone Parts & Accessories focuses on the retail distribution of a wide range of automotive parts and accessories. Our operations include providing customers with quality products such as batteries, filters, brakes, and repair tools, along with expert advice from knowledgeable staff. We prioritize customer service and maintain a clean, secure, and well-organized retail environment to facilitate easy shopping. Our facilities are equipped with appropriate fire protection measures, and we ensure compliance with OSHA regulations to promote a safe workplace. We do not engage in high-risk activities such as racing modifications or self-service repairs, adhering to industry standards to minimize liability and ensure customer safety.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: AutoZone Distribution Center, 5678 Maple Avenue, Memphis, TN 38104-1506
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/15/2023, we experienced a theft of auto parts valued at $5,000. The incident occurred during after-hours when the premises were compromised due to inadequate nighttime security measures. The investigation is ongoing, and measures are being implemented to enhance security protocols to prevent future incidents.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial Safe, Class B, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and on-site watchpersons during off-hours to enhance site security and mitigate theft risk.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – AutoZone Parts & Accessories does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. The business focuses on retail distribution of automotive parts and accessories in a controlled and compliant environment.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – AutoZone Parts & Accessories does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its business operations. The focus remains on retail distribution of automotive parts and providing customer service.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by the designated Inspection Coordinator to ensure compliance and risk management.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property for the applicant.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years for AutoZone Parts & Accessories.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – AutoZone Parts & Accessories does not lease employees to or from other employers. Our staffing is managed in-house to maintain full control over our operations and workforce.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – AutoZone Parts & Accessories carries Workers' Compensation insurance as part of its compliance with statutory requirements for employee coverage. This ensures protection for employees in case of work-related injuries or illnesses.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – AutoZone Parts & Accessories also owns and operates the AutoZone Distribution Center located at 5678 Maple Avenue, Memphis, TN. This facility supports our retail operations by supplying a wide range of automotive parts and accessories.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – AutoZone Parts & Accessories does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. We currently only hold the active policy number AZ-2023-001.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – AutoZone Parts & Accessories does not engage in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our focus is solely on retailing automotive parts and accessories.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – AutoZone Parts & Accessories does not rent or loan equipment to others. The focus is on retailing automotive parts and accessories without engaging in equipment rental activities.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had a foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business maintains a solid financial standing and compliance with industry standards.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – AutoZone Parts & Accessories does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus solely on retailing automotive parts and accessories in a controlled environment. We maintain compliance with safety regulations and prioritize the safe handling of products.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – AutoZone Parts & Accessories does not have any catastrophe exposure as it focuses on retail distribution of automotive parts in a controlled environment and does not engage in high-risk activities.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – AutoZone Parts & Accessories has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The company prioritizes adherence to ethical hiring practices and maintains a strong commitment to a safe and inclusive workplace.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – AutoZone Parts & Accessories has no uncorrected fire code violations, and the facility is equipped with appropriate fire protection measures, ensuring compliance with safety regulations.
